correctness.rationale: An, Drummond-Cole and Knudsen (Theorem 4.5, Proposition 4.9) identify the reduced weight-three complex with graph configuration homology. For GP(10,2) it has C3=Z^9120, C2=Z^22800 and C4=0. Exact integer column operations yield 9094 unit pivots; 26 exact nonzero independent kernel witnesses have each of their boundaries recomputed to zero. With C4=0 the kernel is H3, free rank 26. Independent characteristic-two reduction yields rank 9094; differential-square-zero and graph invariants are checked in verify.py.

value.rationale: The dodecahedral 1-skeleton is an unusually natural symmetric planar cubic graph. Exact top-degree integral homology for three unordered particles is a motivated invariant not fixed by two-particle data or homological-dimension estimates. The 26 independent integral cycles offer a substantial reproducible exact datum; no general theorem or downstream application is presumed.
